g.text: Power-up: supervisors hold POWER_OK low through their release delay, so U227 starts cleared.

g.desc: Power-up: supervisors hold POWER_OK low through their release delay, so U227 starts cleared.

g.text: RUN_PERMIT low clears RUN_ARMED and holds it clear. A new RUN_REQUEST rising edge re-arms only while permitted. TP230 for

g.desc: RUN_PERMIT low clears RUN_ARMED and holds it clear. A new RUN_REQUEST rising edge re-arms only while permitted. TP230 for

g.text: RUN_LATCHED = RUN_REQUEST . RUN_ARMED; replaces RUN_REQUEST in the analogue enable chain.

g.desc: RUN_LATCHED = RUN_REQUEST . RUN_ARMED; replaces RUN_REQUEST in the analogue enable chain.

g.text: ANA_ENABLE = SYS_OK . PACK_OK . SERVICE_OK . RUN_REQUEST . RUN_ARMED. Battery rebound cannot restart analogue power.

g.desc: ANA_ENABLE = SYS_OK . PACK_OK . SERVICE_OK . RUN_REQUEST . RUN_ARMED. Battery rebound cannot restart analogue power.

g.text: RUN_PERMIT = POWER_OK . SERVICE_OK. Low on any SYS, pack or service fault.

g.desc: RUN_PERMIT = POWER_OK . SERVICE_OK. Low on any SYS, pack or service fault.

g.text: Firmware: on any stop drive RUN_REQUEST low; to start, confirm SYS_OK and PACK_OK, hold RUN_REQUEST low >= 1 us, then high. Drive it directly from the GPIO (clock edge <= 10 ns/V, no RC).

g.desc: Firmware: on any stop drive RUN_REQUEST low; to start, confirm SYS_OK and PACK_OK, hold RUN_REQUEST low >= 1 us, then high. Drive it directly from the GPIO (clock edge <= 10 ns/V, no RC).
